_comment: A 'type' is the thing itself (Fresh Milk, Basmati Rice), separate from
the brand that sells it. products.json references a type by key and adds
brand + size. This split exists because the schema stores nine localized
names per PRODUCT row: without it, adding a fourth brand of milk would
mean writing nine more translations for a word already translated three
times. Here each type is translated once and every brand variant reuses
it, so growing the catalogue costs a line per product rather than nine.
It also directly reduces the translation-quality risk flagged in
review has ~170 strings per language to check, not ~500.
keywords: extra search terms — transliterations and common local names —
so a worker searching 'gatas' or 'doodh' finds Milk (master plan
Section 20). They are merged into products.search_keywords at import.
unit: the default unit for this type; a product may override it.
